s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Reddy Kingdom and its inscriptions?

The inscription was found at Kondaveedu, Palnadu district
The Rudrapadam inscription records two Shiva temples built under Anavema Reddy

x: The inscription was discovered under a Tulasi Choura at the Tekkali royal palace in Srikakulam district.

x: The discovery was made by an ASI epigraphy team led by K. Muniratnam Reddy, Director of Epigraphy at ASI, Mysuru. Yadubir Singh Rawat is identified as the Director General of ASI, while Harihara I and Bukka Raya I are associated with the Vijayanagara Empire.
